race.comment: ADRANOS (3) is nearing a breakthrough win after two strong Rocky runs. Has a good record over this trip without winning and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside. Has to carry the big weight but has the peaks to do so and win. LONHY'S FABRE (7) has been solid in three runs back without saluting but comes through strong form references. Should be at his top now and is drawn favourably. Bold showing anticipated. AQUA STORM (4) returns and makes his stable debut. Showed encouraging signs back in Vic and if the Bush camp have him right fresh, he can return with a bang. UNEGA WAHY'A (14) is still a maiden but came close to shedding the tag here fresh off a long break for the new stable. Treading carefully second-up but he does get in light and worth a spot for exotic players.
